description: Said the list back by ear, and asked about players.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Gave a light list, took offence at heavy, and allowed the plot if he arrives.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Tied the knot and spoke over it.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Prayed the two counties and the number he had been given.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Spoke it once, and did not get up again.
name: William Shakespeare
